stations.title: Rhona
stations.say: Will next winter's crew follow it?

stations.title: The code
stations.text: No word on what any function takes or gives

stations.title: Next winter
stations.say: Every def line says it all.
stations.note: Whoever looks after the code next.

captions: At the end of the season, Rhona hands the code to whoever looks after it next winter.
Today no def line says what a function takes, and one says the wrong thing.
You write hints on every function, and the season's report of its longest callouts.
Now each def line says what goes in and what comes out, and the report is sorted.
The season closes, and next winter's crew can read the code without guessing.
